verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own Audit Log Webhooks, which stream audit events to the user's own infrastructure. That is a genuine outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. However, the evidence covers only audit-log events in a single thin mention, with no detail on event types, registration, payloads, or delivery guarantees. missing for 10: webhooks for flag/environment change events, documented event-type selection and registration flow, payload schema/signing and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can stream your Audit Logs into your own infrastructure using Audit Log Webhooks.
